claims.statement: The Rent Roll sheet lists Kestrel Point Logistics Center's building area as 128,400 square feet.
A separate CSV sheet lists the same property's building area as 133,750 square feet.
A PDF comparable-set extract states the building area is 121,900 square feet.

citations.quote:
Kestrel Point Logistics Center is carried in the comparable set at a building area of 121,900
square feet.

claims.statement: Another CSV entry, under a slightly different name 'Kestrel Point Logistics Ctr', lists the building area as 118,300 square feet.

The four sources do not agree on Kestrel Point Logistics Center's building area, reporting four different figures (128,400; 133,750; 121,900; and 118,300 square feet), representing a genuine contradiction in the evidence.

citations.quote:
a building area of 121,900
square feet
